_meta.description: TEMPLATE — copy to mcp-pdf-designer.json and replace the <PLACEHOLDER> paths with your own. The repo runs WITHOUT this file; it only enriches agents and tools with pointers. Nothing here is a secret.

theme_kit.note: www-theme-kit owns Hub layout and responsive behavior; syna-theme-kit owns the generated Aesyna visual-token adapter. Consumers vendor assets; no sibling kit is needed at runtime.

setup.2: Replace <REPO_ROOT> with this clone's absolute path.
setup.3: External kit and voice pointers are optional; remove them if those private repos are unavailable.

modules.check_ats: ATS text-layer guard on light PDF
modules.audit_resume: Diff rendered HTML vs vault omissions

voice.rule: voice-seed = map/public overview; pdf-designer root nouns = deep edit SSOT; agency agents ≠ applicants

breakpoints._role: Project pointer only; named set and numeric tokens live in www-theme-kit. Hub CSS and drawer-resize.js implement the selected profile behavior.
breakpoints.hub_css: src/pdf_tool/static/hub.css (hard-codes the same .98px maxes — CSS cannot var() inside @media)
breakpoints.nav_switch: lg (992px) — scrollable desktop toolbar from lg; drawer below lg

design_hub.port_ssot: python -m pdf_tool.preview --port (default 8787); optional host port registry ~/.user/port-map.txt
design_hub.chrome_layout: 52px toolbar: D identity, pre-rendered mode icons, scrollable controls, pinned actions

palette_registry._role: COLOR. Structure lives in `layouts` below — the two compose.

layouts._role: ⭐ STRUCTURE — where things sit on the page. Tracked and reusable, the counterpart to `palette_registry` (color). Never store a reusable layout in storage/.
layouts.what_earns_a_recipe: Structure only — family, canvas, or fit. A background composes at render time via --bg, so a color-only variant is a flag, not a recipe. Archive duplicates rather than deleting them.

recipe_schema.id: matches the filename stem; used on the CLI
recipe_schema.background: preset id from themes/default-collage.json#backgrounds, or raw CSS
recipe_schema.bestFor: human guidance — when to reach for this recipe

collage._role: Collage document type — the sibling of the resume routine.
collage.output: collages/<project>/_candidates/ (ONE FLAT DIR — canvas/bg/fit encoded in the filename)
rules: Screenshots and any image carrying text render with fit=contain — cropping destroys the content.
Output stays flat: no per-canvas or per-background subfolders.
Reusable layouts are tracked in layouts/collage/, never in gitignored storage/.
Promote with --promote, collect renders with --shelve, retire with --archive. Never copy files by hand — a hand-copied layout is a one-off the next project won't find.

plans.next: See Plans/README.md for the current slice; docs/ROADMAP.md for public product gates.
